blocks.orig: The Fun Retreat Resort in Arusha is a lovely place for families with children, as it is packed with all the entertainment the little ones go crazy for – an indoor playground and a children’s park for the smallest travelers, and bumper cars, fun carts and arcade games for the older ones. All kids adore the Water World – with its large swimming pool with slides and things to climb on. Also, parents don’t need to get bored, with a lovely green garden with hammocks, a spa and yoga centre, and a bar and restaurant to end the day on a high note, after which the whole family can fall asleep in one of the spacious and well-equipped rooms or safari tents spread over the property.
